● Als UX/UI Designer arbeitest du eng mit Entwickler:innen, Stakeholder:innen und

setzt AI-gestützte Workflows ein, damit ihr schneller von der Idee zur Lösung

kommt und besser entscheidet.

User Research mit KI als Thinking Partner

● Du führst qualitative und quantitative Forschung durch, um die Bedürfnisse der

auszuwerten und Muster zu erkennen.

● Du entwickelst Ideen und visualisierst sie als Wireframes und interaktive

Coding baust du klickbare Prototypen, die du direkt mit Nutzer:innen testen kannst.

Usability-Tests & Design-Optimierung

● Du planst und führst Usability-Tests durch, damit deine Designs intuitiv und

benutzerfreundlich sind. Die Testergebnisse wertest du aus, und das Feedback

fließt direkt in die Optimierung der Benutzeroberfläche ein.

● Du gestaltest Erlebnis und Oberfläche des Produkts, damit es gut aussieht und

einfach zu bedienen ist. Dabei arbeitest du mit Design Systems und achtest auf

Barrierefreiheit nach EAA und WCAG.

Designing AI-Native Products

gestalten

● Du arbeitest gern im Team und freust dich, gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern

● Du hast Spaß an agilen Arbeitsmethoden (z. B. Scrum, Kanban) und iterierst

Designs schnell

● Du kannst deine Designideen klar kommunizieren und Stakeholder von deinem

Konzept überzeugen

● Du zeigst Eigeninitiative, bringst kreative Lösungen ein und arbeitest pragmatisch

● Vorerfahrung in Design ist kein Muss, wichtig ist deine Bereitschaft, dich in Tools wie

title: E-Commerce & Marketplace Specialist (m/w/d)
description: PIKA fresh GmbH steht für Premium-Küchenausstattung und innovative Vakuum-Frischhaltesysteme. Als rasant wachsendes Brand vertreiben wir unsere Produkte nicht nur über unseren eigenen Shopify-Store und große Online-Marktplätze, sondern expandieren mit starken Partnern in mittlerweile über 13 Länder. Um unser digitales Wachstum weiter zu beschleunigen, suchen wir ab sofort einen datengetriebenen und umsetzungsstarken E-Commerce & Marketplace Specialist (m/w/d). Kennst du die Algorithmen der großen Plattformen, triffst datenbasierte Entscheidungen und hast einen starken Antrieb, Conversion Rates und Sichtbarkeit kontinuierlich zu optimieren? Dann werde Teil unserer Wachstumsgeschichte! Deine Aufgaben Als E-Commerce & Marketplace Specialist (m/w/d) übernimmst du die operative und analytische Verantwortung für unsere digitalen Vertriebskanäle und treibst das Wachstum proaktiv voran. E‑Commerce & Marketplace Ownership (70 %) Eigenverantwortliches Channel Management: Proaktive Steuerung, Pflege und strategische Weiterentwicklung unserer Marktplatz-Accounts (Amazon, Kaufland, OTTO) sowie unseres D2C Shopify-Stores. Performance & Conversion Optimierung: Kontinuierliche, datengetriebene Verbesserung von Produkt-Listings, A+ Content und Brand Stores durch Keyword-Recherche, SEO-Maßnahmen und strukturiertes A/B-Testing. PPC & Campaign Management: Operatives Setup, Optimierung und Skalierung von Werbekampagnen (Amazon Sponsored Products/Brands, Meta Ads für D2C) mit starkem Fokus auf ROAS, ACoS, CTR und CVR. Tool-basierte Analyse & KI-Nutzung: Souveräner Umgang mit Helium 10, Keepa, Google Analytics, Shopify Analytics sowie KI-Tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney) für Marktanalysen, automatisierte Content-Erstellung und die Ableitung konkreter Handlungsempfehlungen. Operations & Schnittstellenmanagement: Überwachung von Account Health, Lagerbestand (FBA/FBM), Case Handling sowie enge Abstimmung mit Logistik, Einkauf und internationalen Partnern zur Sicherstellung einer reibungslosen Customer Journey. Verantwortung für Social Media & TikTok Shop (30 %) TikTok Shop Management: Setup, Tagesgeschäft, Product Onboarding, Creator-Kooperationen und Performance-Überwachung von TikTok Shop-Kampagnen und Live-Shopping-Formaten. Content Creation (Short‑Form Video): Eigenverantwortliche Produktion von TikToks, Instagram Reels und Meta Short-Form Content – inklusive Ideenfindung, Skripterstellung, Dreh, Schnitt und Veröffentlichung. Creator & Influencer-Kooperationen: Identifikation, Ansprache, Verhandlung und Koordination mit Creators, die zur Markenästhetik von PIKA passen und Verkäufe über den TikTok Shop oder Instagram antreiben können. Social Commerce Optimierung: Kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Produktdetailseiten, Video-Hooks, Thumbnails und UGC-basierten Creatives zur Maximierung der Conversion Rates in Social Commerce-Umgebungen. Community & Trend Monitoring: Aktive Beobachtung von TikTok-Trends, Audio-Mustern, Algorithmus-Änderungen und Wettbewerbsaktivitäten, um sicherzustellen, dass der PIKA-Content relevant und high-performant bleibt. Brand Storytelling: Übersetzung der hochwertigen, modularen Markenidentität von PIKA in ansprechende Social-First-Geschichten, die die Markenbekanntheit stärken und D2C-Verkäufe fördern. Dein Profil Du bist kein reiner Verwalter, sondern ein analytischer Optimierer mit ausgeprägter Hands-on-Mentalität. Berufserfahrung: Du verfügst über 2 bis 4 Jahre fundierte Berufserfahrung im E-Commerce-Umfeld, idealerweise mit direktem Fokus auf Amazon (Seller Central) und Shopify. Expertise: Du verstehst die Ranking-Faktoren von Marktplatz-Algorithmen und weißt genau, an welchen Stellschrauben du drehen musst, um Produkte auf Seite eins zu platzieren. Tech & Datenaffinität: Du bist zahlenstark (Excel/Google Sheets) und hast keine Berührungsängste bei der Nutzung neuer digitaler Tools und Künstlicher Intelligenz. Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest strukturiert, lösungsorientiert und stark KPI-getrieben. Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung für deine Projekte. Kommunikation: Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und sehr gutes Englisch in Wort und Schrift – essenziell um reibungslos mit unseren internationalen Partnern und Teams zu kommunizieren. Was wir dir bieten Wir bieten dir ein agiles Umfeld, in dem deine Expertise einen direkt messbaren Einfluss auf den Unternehmenserfolg hat. Gestaltungsspielraum & Impact: Eine Schlüsselrolle in einem international wachsenden Unternehmen mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und der Möglichkeit, moderne Prozesse (inkl. KI-Integration) aktiv mitzugestalten. Wachstum & Entwicklung: Steile Lernkurven durch internationale Projekte (z. B. Pan-EU-Rollouts) und direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung. Modernes Setup: Ein innovatives Produktportfolio, professionelle digitale Workflows (Microsoft 365, Teams) sowie die Bereitstellung aller relevanten Tools, die du für deinen Erfolg brauchst. Attraktive Rahmenbedingungen: Faire, leistungsgerechte Vergütung, Mitarbeiterrabatte auf unsere Produkte sowie ein hoch motiviertes, internationales Team. Bereit für deinen nächsten Karriereschritt? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Machine Learning Data Scientist posting
description: Role summary: At Differential Bio, our mission is to unlock the potential of the bioeconomy by fixing how biological R&D and scale-up are done. We’re looking for a Machine Learning Data Scientist to join our growing cutting-edge modelling team. You will develop novel machine learning algorithms and mechanistic models of bioprocess systems and push them from research proof-of-concept into production-ready commercial use. This role is focused on research , including creating hybrid models that combine mechanistic and machine learning approaches to predict how microbial fermentations behave , and that keep working when we move to a new organism, a new sensor, or a larger reactor. You’ll play an instrumental role on two existing grants and work with leading academic groups and industrial partners on pilot- and production-scale data. In addition, you’ll develop new research projects and drive them to completion and application on customer projects. We’re interested in researchers who want their work to end up in real bioreactors and are excited about working at an early-stage startup. You should be comfortable owning hard, open-ended problems where nobody has the answer yet, making evidence-based decisions under uncertainty, and shipping real solutions. How you’ll work You’ll collaborate with technical leads and academic/industry external partners to design and execute research that meets our commitments in both consortia and strengthens our own platform. You’ll own your research projects from scoping to delivery, with support from our modelling lead but with autonomy and independence. You’ll work closely with our wet lab, dry lab and software teams, and identify which data you need to generate from our robotic lab. Key responsibilities: Hybrid bioprocess modelling Develop hybrid mechanistic/ML cell response models that predict fermentation outcomes (growth, titer, yield, productivity) from process and sensor data. Fuse time-series signals from process analytical technology (Raman, NIR, dielectric spectroscopy, dissolved oxygen, off-gas) with offline analytics. Build mechanistic backbones (e.g., kinetic/ODE models, genome-scale metabolic models) that constrain learning and generate synthetic training data. Develop machine learning surrogate models for computationally costly mechanistic simulations. Quantify uncertainty so that models can be trusted in high-stakes production settings. Transfer across organisms and scales Design models that carry over from benchtop to pilot and production scale, and across various microbes including bacteria and yeast. Use transfer learning and representation learning to make good predictions for new strains and processes with little data. Develop scale-transferable reactor characterisations and predictive KPI models for scale-up. Real-time Model-Predictive Control Build the AI/ML layer for Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) and reinforcement-learning-based feeding strategies to optimize titer, rate, and yield dynamically. Fuse real-time data from Process Analytical Technology (PAT) and soft sensors (e.g., Raman, NIR) into dynamic state estimators to drive closed-loop bioreactor actuators (feed, air, agitation). Prototype simpler, deployable steps along the way, such as deviation detection and operator alerts Design control frameworks to proactively resolve metabolic bottlenecks and robustly account for model uncertainty, batch-to-batch variability, and inherent bioprocess stochasticity. Qualifications: PhD in machine learning, bioengineering, computational biology, or a related field, or a Master’s degree with 3+ years of relevant industry experience. Strong research independence; ability to scope and execute novel scientific work from start to finish. Demonstrated evidence of research contributions, including (but not limited to): peer-reviewed journal or conference papers, conference attendance, open-source contributions. Strong Python and modern ML tooling (e.g., PyTorch/JAX, scikit-learn). Hands-on experience building models of dynamical systems or time-series data, ideally combining mechanistic and data-driven approaches. Experience working with frontier coding models, including multi-agent orchestration. Clear written and verbal communication, including with non-ML partners. Nice-to-have: Experience with bioprocess or fermentation data, ideally from bioreactors at more than one scale Experience with Raman, NIR, or other spectroscopic data and chemometrics (e.g., PLS) Background in model-predictive control, reinforcement learning, or optimal control Experience with transfer learning, domain adaptation, or representation learning on biological data Familiarity with genome-scale metabolic models or kinetic modelling Experience with Bayesian methods, uncertainty quantification, or design of experiments Experience in collaborative or publicly funded research projects (e.g. Horizon Europe, Eurostars) Benefits: Competitive compensation through salary + stock options; we are looking to build a small but mighty team and think about compensation along those lines; Build your research profile: Work on open problems with leading European academic and industrial partners, with the intention to present and publish your work; A beautiful office in the heart of Munich, or remote work option with occasional travel eGym WellPass membership Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: AI Researcher - Pre-training (f/m/d)
description: Our Mission Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model . Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg. We are hiring an AI Researcher (f/m/d) to join our Pre-training team and help advance the architecture and training of our next generation of foundation models. If you are excited about how large models learn, want to run experiments that feed directly into production training runs, and want hands-on time on large-scale clusters (thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs), we would love to hear from you. Team Culture We foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. We collaborate closely on complex technical problems, working in pairs or using mob programming to resolve challenging issues. New team members learn through real work: from your first weeks you will pair with experienced researchers on live problems, and take on more ownership as you grow into it. About the Role As an AI Researcher in Pre-training (f/m/d) , you will work on the technical levers that determine the success of our next-generation models: architecture, optimization, stability, and scaling. Working at the intersection of research and engineering, you will learn to translate mathematical reasoning and empirical observations into principled training decisions, from small-scale proxy experiments to multi-thousand-GPU runs. You will start with well-scoped problems alongside senior researchers and progressively take ownership of larger parts of the training recipe. raw.title: Senior/Staff Product Designer
raw.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.


We're looking for seasoned Product Designers who thrive in ambiguity and challenging problem spaces.

n8n is a powerful, flexible technical tool, which means the problems you tackle as a designer are complex. Your design decisions must account for diverse user workflows, technical constraints, and how changes impact the entire platform. To thrive here, you will need to love talking to users, understanding technology, and reducing complexity and scope.

You'll be embedded in a product squad alongside a product manager and around three to five engineers, owning the user experience for your area end to end. Our design team is small but growing, so you'll shape the craft bar and the culture, not inherit them.

We're hiring designers across the following teams:

  • Enterprise (two roles - Governance & Observability, and Licence & Billing): You've worked on technical B2B platforms. You've designed for scale, governance, and collaboration across teams, including permissions, environments, observability, and failure modes included and you're comfortable making deeply complex systems feel coherent and simple.

  • Adore - Adoption & Retention: You have exceptional product sense and can connect disparate elements into a coherent whole. You'll take something complex, with many moving parts, and make it make sense - shaping what the visual layer of n8n becomes next. Experience with data visualisation is welcome; deep technical expertise isn't required.

  • n8n Labs: As a Product Designer, you'll own discovery end-to-end, spotting the riskiest assumptions, running the research, and turning findings into decisions without waiting on a brief. You move fast, cut scope without losing what matters, and you're hands-on enough to build and ship your own prototypes, including using AI tools to get there quicker. You've got product and business judgment, not just craft; you can spot an opportunity and make the case for it. Founder or co-founder experience is a helpful signal but not a requirement.

Team assignment is confirmed at the offer stage and may be subject to change as the team structure evolves.

🎯 Regardless of the team, your main goal will be to lead end-to-end product design on complex workflows that elevate n8n's user experience, ship measurable outcomes, and raise the quality bar across our platform. To do so, here are your responsibilities:

End-to-end product design

  • Lead the full design process for your team, from discovery to polished delivery, collaborating closely with PMs and engineers.

  • Consistently ship high-quality, visually cohesive designs that improve the overall UX at every release.

  • Work effectively on complex features and understand the underlying technology.

  • Take ownership of complex, multi-faceted problems and drive them to completion with initiative and autonomy.

Research, feedback, and UX quality

  • Own the direction of research for your team, decide when it's needed, choose the right methodology, and take the initiative without waiting to be told.

  • Champion the user by running interviews, usability tests, and research to inform critical product and business decisions.

  • Master the feedback loop by gathering, synthesizing, and acting on input while giving actionable critique to elevate teammates' work.

  • Balance speed and quality in an MVP-driven environment, navigating ambiguity while maintaining a high bar.

Systems thinking and platform coherence

  • Design in systems, integrating solutions into the broader n8n platform and safeguarding the product's big picture.

  • Account for edge cases, constraints, and interaction details so users never end up in impossible states.

  • Collaborate across teams and designers to ensure consistency and quality across shared patterns and components.

Strategy, impact, and innovation

  • Shape team strategy by influencing planning, prioritization, and scope with a strong design perspective tied to KPIs.

  • Explore and adopt AI and automation tools to push the boundaries of design practice and AI-powered workflows.

Senior or Staff?

We're open at both levels, and we'll calibrate with you during the process. At Senior, you own your squad's design end-to-end and ship work that raises the bar for your area. At Staff, you do that, and your influence reaches beyond your own squad - you shape patterns other designers build on, and you take on the problems that span teams. Both are hands-on: this is not a step away from the craft.


REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🎨 Product design excellence: You're proficient across product design, UX, UI, and qualitative research, delivering polished, detail-oriented work.

  • 🧠 Technical mindset: You collaborate effectively with engineers and understand how software is built, including common web technologies. You don't need to write code, but you do need genuine curiosity about what's happening underneath - APIs, webhooks, data structures and how workflows actually execute.

  • 🧭 Ownership & delivery: You've shipped end-to-end features in smaller teams or startups and can drive complex problems to measurable outcomes.

  • ⚡ Fast, focused execution: You operate at high speed in an MVP-driven environment, balancing quality and velocity amid ambiguity.

  • 📈 Outcome orientation: You use research and metrics to inform decisions and consistently deliver solutions that enable team KPIs.

  • 🤝 Feedback & collaboration: You're open and non-defensive in critique and provide actionable feedback that raises the team's bar.

  • 🧪 Curiosity for AI: You're enthusiastic about AI and innovation, actively exploring new tools and approaches to advance the craft.

  • 📅 Experience level: You have 5+ years in product design with demonstrable impact on shipped products.


Nice-to-haves

  • 💻 Front-end fluency: You can prototype using HTML/CSS/JavaScript, with or without AI coding tools, and can collaborate effectively with engineers on the result.

  • 🧩 AI & automation domain: You've designed AI or automation products; familiarity with n8n is a plus.

  • 🔁 Process improvement: You proactively refine team rituals and workflows to increase effectiveness.

  • 📚 Continuous growth: You invest in your craft and are motivated by creating tangible product and company impact.

  • 🔎 Discovery frameworks: You know methodologies like Continuous Discovery or Shape Up.

  • 📊 Data-informed design: You're comfortable with metrics, A/B testing, or SQL to guide decisions.

  • 🚀 Entrepreneurial drive: You've built startups or side projects that show initiative and creative problem-solving.


Why join us?

At n8n, your work won't disappear into a slide deck. You'll lead high-impact design across core product surfaces, shaping AI-powered workflows, enterprise governance and billing, and how people discover and adopt n8n, from discovery to delivery. You'll join a fast-growing, Europe remote-first company where autonomy, experimentation, and craft matter, partnering closely with PMs and engineers to ship real outcomes to a passionate global community.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now and help us build the future of automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

    • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

  • Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.

  • Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.

  • Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.

*Country and/or State specific details provided in your employment agreement.

description: Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co . We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions About the role You’ll grow a portfolio of our most important automotive OEM and supplier accounts in EMEA, working hand in hand with our Business Development leaders. Our deals are large, technical and multi-year. These deals are built on a foundation of understanding multiple technical and business stakeholders, from individual engineers, to leadership and C-suite. You will need to spend time understanding what an engineering team is battling, what the program manager is worried about, how to gain support and buy in from procurement and purchasing teams, and what the CTO is trying to achieve at a strategic level, then pull these threads together to build a successful deal. You'll work hand in hand with solution engineering and business development teams to shape, build and close deals. Internally, you’ll coordinate engineering, product, legal and finance to deliver on what we commit. At Applied Intuition, you will: Own critical client relationships and expand reach into key accounts including major OEM and Tier 1 relationships. Drive strategic alignment and executive engagement across R&D, procurement and other relevant teams Grow current footprint across Applied Intuition's solutions and land multi year commercial deals, including securing renewal risks We're looking for someone who has: Bachelor's degree 5-10 years of experience automotive software / platform / semiconductor sales into Automotive OEMs Track record of securing large scale, multi year software deals Strong knowledge of a complex software sales process, including ability to map stakeholders, leverage key contacts and drive progress through legal, following up and maintaining CRM hygiene Nice to have: Technical fluency around Software Defined Vehicle technical topics, ADAS/AD, ADAS validation, SIL/HIL toolchains Ability to have a technical conversation without the presence of a solution engineer Strong network inside at least one or more major European Automotive OEMs Masters in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or comparable Engineering subject MBA Compensation at Applied Intuition for eligible roles includes base salary, equity, and benefits. Base salary is a single component of the total compensation package, which may also include equity in the form of options and/or restricted stock units, comprehensive health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance coverage, 401k retirement benefits with employer match, learning and wellness stipends, and paid time off. Note that benefits are subject to change and may vary based on jurisdiction of employment. Applied Intuition pay ranges reflect the minimum and maximum intended target base salary for new hire salaries for the position. The actual base salary offered to a successful candidate will additionally be influenced by a variety of factors including experience, credentials & certifications, educational attainment, skill level requirements, interview performance, and the level and scope of the position. Don’t meet every single requirement? title: Forward Deployed Engineer (m/f/x)
description: About Virtual Identity Virtual Identity (VI) is a digital agency built on Human-Centered Business Growth: combining empathy for people with insight from data to drive real digital success. With around 140 colleagues across Freiburg, Munich, Vienna, and Porto (and remote), we cover the full spectrum from Consulting and UX Research to UX/UI Design, Software Development, and Digital Marketing — always learning in close collaboration with our clients. As a Forward Deployed Engineer at VI, you sit at the intersection of client, product, and engineering. You're not building in isolation from a backlog handed down by someone else — you go into deep, sustained virtual immersion with the client, understand their real operational problems, and ship working software that solves them, fast. You prototype, integrate, and iterate directly with the people who will use what you build, then help harden it into something production-ready with our delivery teams. You also bring a well-founded understanding of agentic engineering — not just using AI coding assistants, but genuinely understanding how agents plan, use tools, and fail, and applying that thinking to how you build, integrate, and automate in the field. This role suits someone who's equally comfortable in a client workshop, a codebase, and a data pipeline — and who gets energy from ambiguity rather than needing it resolved before starting. What you will do: Embed with client teams to observe workflows, diagnose bottlenecks, and identify where custom software can create outsized impact. Rapidly prototype and deploy solutions — internal tools, integrations, automations, data pipelines — directly in the client's environment. Translate messy, real-world requirements into working code without waiting for a fully specified brief. Own the full loop: build, deploy, get feedback from actual users within days, iterate. Use agentic engineering practices — not just AI-assisted coding, but designing workflows, automations, and integrations that leverage agents as a core part of the solution, where it genuinely helps the client. Work closely with VI's UX, consulting, and cloud-native engineering teams to transition prototypes into scalable, supportable production systems. Navigate client infrastructure, security constraints, and existing systems (cloud platforms, APIs, legacy tools) pragmatically. Act as a trusted technical voice in client conversations — you can whiteboard an architecture and defend it in the same meeting. Travel to client sites as needed (frequency depends on engagement). What we expect: Strong full-stack or cloud-native engineering experience, with a track record of shipping real software, not just prototypes that die in a demo. Comfort working directly with non-technical stakeholders and translating their problems into technical solutions on the fly. Solid grounding in at least one modern backend stack and one frontend stack, plus working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Experience with APIs, data integration, and automation — you can connect systems that were never designed to talk to each other. Real, well-founded knowledge of agentic engineering — you understand the underlying concepts (agent planning, tool use, context management, orchestration, evaluation), not just the tool names, and you've applied that thinking to real work, not side projects. A bias toward action: you'd rather build a rough version and test it with real users than perfect a spec. Strong communication skills — you can explain a technical trade-off to a client stakeholder without jargon. Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities; forward deployed work is inherently unstructured. Willingness to travel to client sites. Experience in an agency, consultancy, or client-facing technical role (nice to have). Familiarity with UX research or design collaboration workflows (nice to have). Exposure to enterprise integration patterns or legacy system modernization (nice to have). Hands-on experience building or deploying agentic systems for a client, not just personal productivity use (nice to have). A relevant degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field — but we care more about what you've built (nice to have). What you can expect from us Exciting projects with well-known brands, a team of motivated colleagues who genuinely enjoy working together, and continuous learning through our VI Academy. Whether you're based in one of our offices or working fully remote, we give you the room to grow — professionally and personally. Sound like your kind of place? We'd love to hear from you. title: Senior Materials Engineer (all genders)
description: Your Mission: As Senior Materials Engineer (all genders) you will lead material selection for the propulsion battery system of VÆRIDION's CS-23 all-electric aircraft. You will identify the best material for each application, from composites and metals to adhesives, gaskets, and insulation materials, and own the material requirements and evidence that support each choice. Through trade studies, characterization, and close supplier engagement, you will make sure that every material in the propulsion battery system performs safely in normal operation, under abuse, and during thermal runaway. Within the Mechanical Design & Integration team, you will work closely with Mechanical Design and Materials & Processes, and support the Thermal Systems, HV Electrical Systems, Airborne Electronics, and Cell Technology teams wherever material choices matter, including thermal adhesives, electrical bonding, and insulation. As development matures, you will hand over qualification and process ownership to Materials & Processes while remaining the technical authority on material behaviour. Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION's mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation. Your Day-to-Day: Lead material selection for the propulsion battery system, including composites, metals, adhesives, gaskets, seals, potting compounds, and thermal and electrical insulation materials. Lead structured material trade studies that balance mechanical, thermal, electrical, chemical, weight, cost, and supply chain considerations. Own material requirements for normal operation, abuse, and failure cases, including thermal runaway, fire, venting, crash, vibration, humidity, and fluid exposure. Evaluate high-temperature and fire protection materials, such as phenolic and high-char-yield composites, silicone systems, ceramics, and intumescent materials, for thermal runaway containment. Provide material property data and guidance on material-driven design features to the Mechanical Design team. Support material choices for thermal adhesives, gap fillers, electrical bonding, and insulation together with the Thermal Systems, HV Electrical Systems, and Airborne Electronics teams. Draft test requests (TRQs) for material characterization and work with the test team and suppliers to execute them. Analyse test data and derive design-relevant material properties and conclusions. Own technical relationships with material suppliers, including requirements alignment, data requests, and the evaluation of new material candidates. Define material specifications and approved-material definitions together with Materials & Processes. Contribute to material qualification and certification substantiation, transferring ownership to Materials & Processes as development matures. Assess material compatibility and durability over the service life, including chemical compatibility with coolants and electrolytes, galvanic corrosion between dissimilar materials, moisture uptake, outgassing, and property retention after thermal cycling and accelerated aging, as well as resistance to thermal runaway vent gases and ejecta, working with the Materials & Processes Engineer where processing such as cure state or surface preparation affects the result. Lead failure investigations and root cause analyses where material behaviour is a contributor. Consider regulatory constraints such as REACH and RoHS in material selection. Act as the technical authority on materials in design reviews and technical discussions with suppliers and partners. Mentor engineers and build materials expertise across the Technology division. Your Profile: Master's degree or PhD in Materials Science & Engineering. 5+ years of experience in materials engineering, preferably in aerospace, battery systems, or other safety-critical industries. Deep understanding of structure-property-processing relationships in polymers, composites, metals, and ceramics. Proven ability to select the best material for a given application, based on data and first principles. Experience with material characterization methods such as mechanical testing, DSC, TGA, DMA, cone calorimetry, and microscopy. Experience planning tests, interpreting results, and correlating them with design requirements. Strong knowledge of thermoset and thermoplastic composites, adhesives, and elastomers. Knowledge of high-temperature material performance and fire, smoke, and toxicity behaviour is desirable. Experience leading technical work with material suppliers. Familiarity with CS-23, DO-160, DO-311A, and CMH-17 is beneficial. Working proficiency with 3D CAD, such as CATIA, SolidWorks, or Siemens NX, is beneficial. Strong problem-solving skills, technical curiosity, and attention to detail. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. German is a plus. Passionate about aviation and the electrification of flight. We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist. Why us? Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation. We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments. Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us. Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days. Become a part of our success with virtual stock options. Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket. Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability. Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security. Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft. Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects. Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports). raw.title: EMI, HIRF, Lightning Engineer (all genders)
raw.description:
Your Mission:

We are looking for an EMI/EMC, HIRF & Lightning Engineer (all genders) to join our Central Engineering team and support electromagnetic compatibility and electromagnetic environmental effects activities for the Microliner aircraft.

You will be responsible for the day-to-day engineering activities related to EMI/EMC, High-Intensity Radiated Fields (HIRF), and lightning protection throughout the aircraft development lifecycle, from requirements and architecture support through analysis, design integration, testing, verification, and certification. Working closely with colleagues from Systems, Propulsion, Airframe, Safety, Verification and Validation, and Certification, you will ensure that electromagnetic environmental effects are appropriately addressed at aircraft, system, equipment, and installation level.

As part of Central Engineering, you will act as an internal focal point for EMI/EMC, HIRF, and lightning engineering. Working within the established technical approach and with guidance from senior subject-matter expertise, you will independently drive engineering activities within your area, coordinate across disciplines and suppliers, resolve technical issues, and develop substantiated recommendations for higher-level technical decisions.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Develop and maintain aircraft-level EMI/EMC, HIRF, and lightning requirements within the established technical framework, supporting their decomposition, allocation, and verification across aircraft systems, equipment, installations, and structures.

  • Perform and coordinate EMI/EMC, HIRF, and lightning assessments, including interference sources, coupling paths, equipment susceptibility, installation effects, and direct and indirect lightning effects.

  • Develop, assess, and support the implementation of protection and mitigation measures, including shielding, grounding and bonding, filtering, cable routing and separation, equipment installation, and structural protection provisions.

  • Support the maturation of the aircraft EMI/EMC, HIRF, and lightning protection approach, evaluating technical solutions, identifying risks and trade-offs, and developing substantiated recommendations for higher-level technical decisions.

  • Define and coordinate verification and qualification activities within the assigned scope, including analysis, inspection, equipment qualification, ground and aircraft testing, and testing performed by external laboratories.

  • Independently investigate and resolve electromagnetic interference and compatibility issues during equipment development, system integration, and testing, involving senior technical expertise where significant architectural or programme-level decisions are required.

  • Support safety, certification, and compliance activities, including preparation and review of assessments, qualification evidence, verification results, and compliance documentation in accordance with applicable standards.

  • Act as an internal technical focal point for EMI/EMC, HIRF, and lightning topics, coordinating with engineering teams, suppliers, test laboratories, and technical specialists, while contributing to the continuous improvement of related engineering methods and processes.

 

Your Profile:

  • Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, or a comparable technical discipline, with a minimum of 4 years of professional experience in EMI/EMC, HIRF, lightning protection, or related electromagnetic environmental effects.

  • Practical experience in EMI/EMC engineering, including emissions and susceptibility/immunity, grounding and bonding, shielding, filtering, cable installation, and electromagnetic coupling, combined with experience in HIRF and/or lightning protection.

  • Working knowledge of relevant aerospace standards and guidance, such as RTCA DO-160 / EUROCAE ED-14 and the SAE ARP541x series, with experience supporting related analysis, testing, or equipment qualification.

  • Good understanding of aircraft electrical and electronic systems and their integration; experience with high-voltage architectures, electric propulsion, power electronics, or composite aircraft structures is a strong plus.

  • Experience with civil aircraft development and certification under EASA CS-23/CS-25, FAA Part 23/25, or comparable frameworks is desirable; experience within an EASA Part 21J Design Organisation is a plus.

  • Understanding of systems and safety engineering principles for safety-critical aircraft systems, preferably with exposure to SAE ARP4754 and ARP4761.

  • Ability to work with a high degree of autonomy within an established technical framework, while recognizing when technical issues require broader coordination, specialist input, or escalation.

  • Structured, analytical, and solution-oriented professional with strong technical ownership and the ability to investigate complex electromagnetic interactions and translate findings into practical design recommendations.

  • Strong communication and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering disciplines, suppliers, test laboratories, and technical specialists.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Strong motivation for aviation and the advancement of electric aircraft technologies.

title: Fullstack Developer (m/w/d)
description: Fullstack Developer (m/w/d) Deine Mission Du entwickelst Anwendungen, die Menschen im Arbeitsalltag tatsächlich Arbeit abnehmen. Von der verständlichen Oberfläche über die Backend-Logik bis zur Anbindung bestehender Systeme. Bei Agentur Philipp bauen wir KI-Lösungen und individuelle Software für den Mittelstand. Dafür suchen wir einen Fullstack Developer, der Anforderungen hinterfragt, technisch mitdenkt und Anwendungen zuverlässig in den produktiven Einsatz bringt. Du arbeitest je nach Projekt mit unterschiedlichen Technologien: JavaScript und TypeScript im Frontend, PHP und Laravel, Node.js oder Python im Backend. Gemeinsam mit dem Team wählst du die passende Lösung. Deine Aufgaben Du entwickelst Webanwendungen vom Frontend bis zum Backend und begleitest sie bis zum produktiven Betrieb. Du baust verständliche Benutzeroberflächen mit React, Next.js, Vue.js oder vergleichbaren Frameworks. Du entwickelst Backends und APIs mit PHP und Laravel, Node.js oder Python und FastAPI, passend zu den Anforderungen des Projekts. Du bindest bestehende Kunden-, ERP- und Drittsysteme an und sorgst für einen zuverlässigen Datenaustausch. Du entwirfst Datenmodelle und setzt Geschäftslogik, Benutzerverwaltung, Rollen und Berechtigungen sauber um. Du integrierst KI-Funktionen und automatisierte Workflows in unsere Anwendungen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unseren KI- und Automatisierungsentwicklern zusammen. Du sorgst mit Tests, Logging und Fehlerbehandlung dafür, dass Anwendungen auch außerhalb des Idealfalls funktionieren. Du entwickelst bestehende Systeme weiter und behältst Wartbarkeit, Sicherheit und Performance im Blick. Du stimmst technische Anforderungen mit der Projektleitung ab und machst frühzeitig sichtbar, wenn etwas unklar ist oder aufwendiger wird. Du dokumentierst wichtige technische Entscheidungen so, dass andere im Team deine Arbeit nachvollziehen und weiterführen können. Das bringst du mit Praktische Erfahrung darin, Webanwendungen eigenständig vom Frontend bis zum Backend zu entwickeln und produktiv einzusetzen. Sehr gute Kenntnisse in JavaScript und TypeScript sowie Erfahrung mit React, Next.js, Vue.js oder einem vergleichbaren Frontend-Framework. Gute Kenntnisse in PHP und praktische Erfahrung mit Laravel. Erfahrung mit Node.js oder Python, idealerweise mit einem Backend-Framework wie Express, NestJS oder FastAPI. Sicherer Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken wie MySQL oder PostgreSQL sowie Erfahrung mit Datenmodellierung und Datenbankmigrationen. Erfahrung mit REST-APIs, Authentifizierung und der Integration externer Systeme. Routine im Umgang mit Git, Docker und gängigen Deployment-Prozessen. Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind Voraussetzung. Du kannst Anforderungen, technische Rückfragen und Abstimmungen im Team und mit unseren Kunden sicher auf Deutsch klären. Du denkst an Berechtigungen, Datenschutz und Fehlerfälle, bevor die Anwendung beim Kunden läuft. Du arbeitest dich in bestehende Codebasen und neue Technologien ein. title: Senior Delivery Recruiter Tech (m/w/d), 180° Delivery, 100 % Remote
description: Die meisten Recruiter sind Postboten. Wir nicht. Die Branche ist kaputt. Hunderte Kandidaten werden angespammt, CVs blind rausgeschickt, und dann wird gebetet. Das Ergebnis sind genervte Kunden, verbrannte Talente und Placement-Quoten zum Weinen. Bei Recruitment Circle machen wir Delivery anders: mit Daten, Psychologie und einem Auswahlverfahren, das Blender aussortiert, bevor der Kunde sie sieht. Das Ergebnis: 7 von 10 Kandidaten, die wir einreichen, landen im Interview. Der Markt liegt bei 10–20 %. Dein Job: reines Delivery. Du bekommst die Mandate. Du lieferst die Menschen. Punkt. Dein Erfolg wird an Placements gemessen, nicht an Stunden: Monat 1: Du steuerst die Prozesse eines Key-Accounts eigenständig. Monat 2: Deine erste Vermittlung ist durch. Monat 6: Du hast 60.000 € Umsatz geliefert. Monat 12: Du stehst bei 250.000 € Jahresumsatz und bist eine Bank in der Delivery. Was du mitbringst 3+ Jahre Agentur-Recruiting , idealerweise bei einem kleineren Personaldienstleister. Du weißt, was Dienstleistung heißt. Sourcing-Skills: LinkedIn Recruiter, Xing, GitHub, Stack Overflow, und Lust auf neue Tools wie Juicebox und Clay. Du findest die passiven Talente, die sonst keiner erreicht. Biss im Interview: Du bohrst nach, bis die echte Performance auf dem Tisch liegt. Augenhöhe: Du sprichst mit CTOs und Practice Leads als Experte, nicht als Bittsteller. Extreme Ownership: Bei dir fällt nichts runter. Ein schweres Profil ist für dich eine Challenge, kein Grund zu jammern. Was du bekommst Geld, das Leistung abbildet: 50–60k Fix, 5–20 % Provision ab dem ersten Euro, 100k+ OTE für alle, die liefern. 100 % Remote, deutschlandweit: Kein Pendeln, keine Präsenzpflicht. Tech-Stack, der arbeitet: Recruit CRM, Apollo, Clay, Juicebox und eigene Automatisierungs-Workflows. Wir bauen die Maschine, du bedienst die Hebel. RC-Masterclass: Du lernst, Lebensläufe zu sezieren und A-Player von Blendern zu trennen Zeitnah verfügbar? Umso besser. Schick uns dein LinkedIn-Profil und deine Placement-Zahlen der letzten 12 Monate. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Customer Success Onboarding Specialist (m/w/d)
description: Unsere Vision Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden. Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen. Deine Mission Du bist die Stimme unserer deutschen Kunden und trägst direkt dazu bei, dass sie mit Pennylane erfolgreich sind. Du hilfst kleinen und mittleren Unternehmen (KMU), ihre Finanzprozesse zu vereinfachen und das volle Potenzial unserer Finanzmanagement-Plattform auszuschöpfen. Gleichzeitig gestaltest du mit uns den Aufbau von Pennylane in Deutschland. Deine Aufgaben Onboarding mit Wirkung: Du begleitest neue KMU-Kunden und ihre Steuerkanzleien durch den gesamten Onboarding-Prozess. Du sorgst dafür, dass der Einstieg reibungslos gelingt und Unternehmen schnell von den Möglichkeiten unserer Plattform profitieren. Kundenbeziehungen aufbauen und weiterentwickeln: Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für unsere bestehenden KMU-Kunden. Du baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf, erkennst Potenziale für zusätzliche Funktionen und eine erweiterte Nutzung und hilfst deinen Kunden, ihre unternehmerischen und finanziellen Ziele mit Pennylane zu erreichen. Proaktiv beraten: In regelmäßigen Gesprächen prüfst du, wie erfolgreich deine Kunden mit Pennylane arbeiten und wo sie Unterstützung brauchen. Du steigerst ihre Zufriedenheit, optimierst die Nutzung der Plattform und erkennst frühzeitig, wenn eine Abwanderung droht. Gemeinsam den deutschen Markt gestalten: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem deutschen Sales-Team und dem lokalen Leadership-Team zusammen. Gemeinsam entwickelt ihr Abläufe weiter, bündelt Produktfeedback und treibt das Wachstum von Pennylane in Deutschland voran. Expertise aufbauen und teilen: Du entwickelst dich zur gefragten Ansprechperson für unsere Plattform und die deutsche Finanz- und Buchhaltungslandschaft. Dein Wissen und bewährte Vorgehensweisen gibst du direkt an unsere KMU-Kunden weiter. Das bringst du mit Relevante Erfahrung: Du hast 2–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung, im Finanzmanagement, in Corporate Finance oder in einer vergleichbaren unternehmensinternen Rolle. Idealerweise hast du selbst mit Finanzprozessen, Rechnungsstellung oder Buchhaltungsabläufen gearbeitet. Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Umfeld, bei einem Fintech oder in einer Steuerkanzlei ist ein Plus. Fachliche Grundlage: Du hast ein Studium mit Schwerpunkt Finanzen, Rechnungswesen oder Betriebswirtschaft abgeschlossen. Alternativ bringst du eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellter, eine Weiterbildung als Steuerfachwirt oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation im Rechnungswesen mit. Verständnis für den deutschen Markt: Du kennst die Anforderungen von KMU an ihr Finanzmanagement und verstehst die zentralen Abläufe rund um Rechnungswesen, Rechnungsstellung und das finanzielle Tagesgeschäft in Deutschland. Kommunikationsstärke und Empathie: Du hörst aufmerksam zu, versetzt dich in deine Kunden hinein und erklärst komplexe finanzielle oder technische Themen einfach und verständlich. Lust, selbst anzupacken: Du möchtest Teil eines Teams sein, das in Deutschland noch am Anfang steht und wächst. Du ergreifst die Initiative, denkst in Lösungen und hast Freude daran, Prozesse von Grund auf mitzugestalten. Reisebereitschaft: Du freust dich darauf, unser Team beim Onboarding im Pariser Headquarter kennenzulernen, und bist bereit, gelegentlich Kunden in Deutschland zu besuchen – etwa einmal im Monat. Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder verhandlungssicherem Niveau (C2) und fließend Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren internationalen Teams. Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen Du kannst remote aus deinem Wohnsitz arbeiten, solange es in Deutschland liegt. Regelmäßige Arbeit aus dem europäischen Ausland ist möglich, wenn die Zeitverschiebung zur MEZ (Mitteleuropäische Zeit) maximal zwei Stunden beträgt. Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage. Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket. Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust. Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann. Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung. Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen. Wen wir suchen Um bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du: Englischkenntnisse (das Niveau wird je nach Abteilung, für die du dich bewirbst, bewertet und eingeschätzt). Begeisterung für ein sich ständig wandelndes Arbeitsumfeld. Hohe Kooperationsbereitschaft (innerhalb deines Teams oder mit anderen Stakeholdern). Ausreichend Erfahrung, um deine täglichen Aufgaben nach geschäftlichen Prioritäten auszurichten. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Performance Creative Manager (m/w/d)
description: Du denkst in Hooks, Angles und Testing-Loops und willst sehen, was deine Ideen im Ad Account bewegen? Wir sind GORNATION - eine Sportmarke aus Münster, gegründet 2015 mit der Mission, Calisthenics weltweit zu stärken. Unsere Produkte werden in über 100 Ländern genutzt - von Trainings-Equipment bis Streetwear. Paid Ads sind unser Hebel für Skalierung. Auf Instagram erreichen wir bereits über 270.000 Menschen, und mit starken Creatives auf Meta und Google wollen wir noch mehr Menschen für Calisthenics und GORNATION begeistern. Wir suchen einen Performance Creative Manager , der unsere Ad Production von der ersten Idee bis zur Auswertung steuert. Du entwickelst Konzepte, planst Shootings, briefst unsere Cutter und sorgst dafür, dass regelmäßig neue Ads live gehen. Dein Ziel: mehr Ad Output in besserer Qualität, mehr Winning Concepts und Creatives, mit denen wir unseren Ad Spend skalieren können. Arbeitsmodell: ab 30 Stunden/Woche, vor Ort in Münster - weil Konzeption, Shootings und schnelles Feedback im Team live noch besser funktionieren. Start: 01.01.2027 Aufgaben Ad Production steuern: Du planst den Produktionsfunnel für Evergreen Ads und Aktionen und sorgst für einen konstanten Output an neuen Creatives. Konzepte entwickeln: Du recherchierst Trends, Formate und Ad Libraries und entwickelst daraus Konzepte, Hooks und Angles für Meta und Google. Shootings & UGC organisieren: Du planst und begleitest interne Ad Shootings und stimmst dich mit unseren Athleten zu Organic Reposts und UGC ab. Feedback-Loops mit Cuttern: Du briefst unsere Cutter, gibst Feedback zu Ad-Versionen und schneidest bei Bedarf selbst. Performance auswerten: Gemeinsam mit unserem Media Buyer analysierst du die Ergebnisse, leitest Learnings ab und bringst sie direkt in die nächsten Konzepte ein. Aktionen begleiten: Bei allen Kampagnen mit Paid-Anteil bist du von Anfang an dabei und planst die passenden Creatives rechtzeitig. Qualifikation Erfahrung in der Ad-Konzeption: Du hast bereits Ads konzipiert oder mit UGC gearbeitet, idealerweise im D2C-Umfeld, und weißt, warum ein Creative performt. Organisation & Projektmanagement: Du behältst Konzepte, Shootings und Deadlines parallel im Blick und setzt klare Prioritäten. Selbstständige Arbeitsweise: Du treibst Themen eigenständig voran und wartest nicht auf Anweisungen. Bezug zur Szene: Du bist in der Fitness- oder Calisthenics-Welt zuhause und verstehst unsere Community. Kommunikationsstärke: Du stimmst dich mit Media Buyer, Cuttern, Athleten, Content Team und externen Partnern ab und bleibst auch bei kurzfristigen Änderungen klar. Hands-on & belastbar: Shooting-Deadlines und viele Stakeholder bringen dich nicht aus der Ruhe. Du arbeitest strukturiert und zuverlässig. Solide Sprachkenntnisse: Du hast sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, um Hooks, Scripts und Briefings sicher umzusetzen. Background: Ob Studium, Ausbildung oder Quereinstieg - entscheidend ist deine praktische Erfahrung. Nice-to-have: Erfahrung im Schnitt, mit Asana oder anderen Projekttools sowie ein Grundverständnis für Fotografie und Videografie. Benefits Top Arbeits-Equipment: Du bekommst ein MacBook für deine Arbeit, das dir hilft, produktiv und effizient zu arbeiten. Fitness inklusive: Wir trainieren regelmäßig gemeinsam nach der Arbeit, entweder in unserem Fitnessraum im Office-Gebäude oder draußen. Steuerfreier Sachbezug: Du erhältst eine Sport-Mitgliedschaft, eine betriebliche Krankenversicherung oder eine Tankkarte als steuerfreien Sachbezug. Teamevents & Networking: Neben tollen Teamevents bekommst du auch die Gelegenheit, mit internationalen Calisthenics-Athleten in Kontakt zu treten und von ihnen zu lernen. Erlebe die FIBO: Mit deinem 4-Tage-Ticket für die FIBO - der größten Fitnessmesse der Welt - hast du Zugang zur Fitness-Welt in Köln. Komfort bei der Arbeit: Jeder Arbeitsplatz ist mit einem höhenverstellbaren Schreibtisch ausgestattet, damit du zwischen Sitzen und Stehen wechseln kannst, um produktiv und gesund zu bleiben. Kaffee- & Wasser-Flat: Genieße erstklassigen Kaffee aus unserer hochwertigen Kaffeemaschine und stets frisches Wasser aus unserer Wasserfilteranlage. Exklusive Rabatte: Profitiere von Mitarbeiterrabatten auf unser Equipment und unsere Kleidung für dein Training. Persönliche Zusammenarbeit im Office: Wir setzen auf echte Begegnungen im Büro in Münster statt endloser Online-Calls. Unser Ziel: Ein Office, in dem man sich wohlfühlt und in das man gerne kommt. Hundefreundlicher Arbeitsplatz: Nach Absprache kannst du deinen Hund mit ins Büro nehmen. E-Auto-Ladestation am Campus: Du kannst dein E-Auto bequem direkt am Office laden. Wenn du Lust hast, unsere Ad Production aufzubauen, eigene Konzepte an den Start zu bringen und Teil eines motivierten Teams vor Ort in Münster zu werden, dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. title: Senior Marketing Manager- Burson
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Who we are:</strong></h3> <p>Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.</p> <p>WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <a href="WPP.com">WPP.com</a>&nbsp;</p> <p>For more information visit&nbsp;<a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/">bursonglobal.com</a> and follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/burson/posts/?feedView=all">LinkedIn</a> and&nbsp;<a href="https://www.instagram.com/burson.global/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.</p></div><p><strong>More about the role:</strong></p> <p>We are looking for an ambitious, commercially minded <strong>Senior Marketing Manager</strong> to help Burson drive visibility, relevance and connection to the clients and prospects we most want to work with.</p> <p>Sitting at the heart of the UK Growth Team, this is a high-profile role working closely with the Chief Growth Officer and senior leaders across the business. You will help further Burson’s momentum in the UK having been named Cannes Lions Agency of the year 2026, turning our best thinking, expertise, people and client work into marketing that builds our reputation, creates demand and opens doors.</p> <p>You will be responsible for growing Burson's reputation and visibility in the market, strengthening engagement with priority audiences and building marketing programmes that support our growth ambitions across all areas of our business.</p> <p>We are looking for someone with ideas, energy and excellent judgement. Someone who understands what makes senior decision-makers pay attention, knows how to turn complex expertise into compelling stories and can mobilise a busy organisation behind a great idea.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <div> <ul> <li>Develop and deliver a focused UK marketing strategy that builds brand awareness, distinctiveness and demand, aligned with business and growth priorities.</li> <li>Strengthen Burson’s profile among&nbsp;priority clients, prospects, industry influencers, business leaders and future talent, positioning us as a modern strategic advisory partner.</li> <li>Build a distinctive&nbsp;thought leadership and editorial programme, turning our expertise, insights, data and senior counsel into timely and compelling content across multiple channels.</li> <li>Identify key moments across the&nbsp;business, media and cultural agenda where Burson can lead the conversation, mobilising experts and building the external profiles of senior leaders.</li> <li>Create an engaging events and experiences programme, including briefings, roundtables, webinars and partnerships that deepen relationships with clients and prospects.</li> <li>Showcase Burson’s best work through case studies, credentials, awards and external storytelling, increasing visibility and recognition for our people, expertise and client impact.</li> <li>Build a modern, high-performing marketing engine, using AI, automation, media intelligence, data and measurement to make marketing faster, smarter and more effective.</li> <li>Partner closely with UK leadership, Growth, practices, capabilities and the EMEA Marketing Team to maximise commercial impact, amplify regional and global programmes, and share the best of Burson UK across the wider network.</li> </ul> </div> <p><strong>Experience that contributes to success:</strong></p> <p>We're looking for an ambitious marketer who combines the instincts of a<strong> </strong>marketer, editor and connector, and who likes making things happen.</p> <p>You'll bring:</p> <ul> <li>A strong track record in B2B or professional-services marketing, ideally within strategic communications, consulting, creative, technology or another expertise-led business.</li> <li>Evidence that you have helped build a brand, audience or market position, rather than simply managed marketing activity.</li> <li>Experience developing and delivering high-impact thought leadership, content and integrated marketing programmes.</li> <li>Excellent editorial judgement. You know what makes an interesting point of view, what will engage an external audience and what won't.</li> <li>Outstanding writing and storytelling skills, with an ability to turn complex ideas into clear, engaging narratives.</li> <li>Commercial instinct and an understanding of the relationship between reputation, relationships, marketing and new business.</li> <li>Confidence working with senior leaders, including the ability to advise, influence and challenge constructively.</li> <li>A strong understanding of AI-enabled marketing, together with curiosity about how emerging technology can improve insight, creativity, personalisation, productivity and measurement.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of the communications, marketing and wider business landscape, with a natural curiosity about what's happening in the world.</li> <li>A proactive approach to building external relationships with industry influencers, partners, media stakeholders and senior decision-makers.</li> <li>A bias for action. You spot opportunities, bring ideas and make them happen.</li> <li>High standards and exceptional attention to detail, without allowing perfection to get in the way of momentum.</li> <li>A collaborative mindset and the ability to bring people together across Growth, practices, capabilities, creative teams and regional marketing colleagues.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What success looks like</strong></p> <p>You will help create a Burson UK that feels<strong> </strong>impossible to ignore: sharper in the market, faster into important conversations and better at turning our expertise into reputation, relationships and growth.</p> <p>Success will mean:</p> <ul> <li>greater visibility and distinctiveness for Burson amongst priority audiences;</li> <li>stronger engagement with the clients and prospects we most want to reach;</li> <li>a recognisable and consistent flow of distinctive Burson attitude, thinking and expertise into the market;</li> <li>greater visibility for our senior experts and our best client work;</li> <li>marketing programmes, content and experiences that create meaningful conversations and support growth; and</li> <li>a faster, smarter and more measurable marketing operation.</li> </ul> <p>This is an opportunity to help shape not simply how Burson markets itself in the UK, but how the market sees Burson and what we are capable of.</p> <p><strong>#LI-CY1</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>You belong at Burson:</strong></h3> <p>Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.</p> <p>At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.</p> <p>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection.   • Fuel & Socials: Enjoy tea, coffee and snacks daily. Every last Wednesday of the month, we host a Team Lunch where the menu is chosen by you. We also run regular team socials, alongside company and individual milestone celebrations.

Tech 💻

  • Custom Setup: You’ll receive a high-spec MacBook Pro and £150 toward a mouse and keyboard of your choice.

  • Stage 1: Screening with Talent Lead

  • Stage 4: Final Behavioural interview

About Griffin

Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences.

We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more.

We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies.

Learn more about what we do

Our culture

We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible.

We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life.

We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified.

Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers.

Learn more about our culture.

The team

We’re the Connect team, what most companies call Sales. We strive to bring the best in technology, user experience and banking to the embedded finance space and be the bank for fintechs and corporates to build on.

We’re 10 people across Commercial, Customers Success and Marketing, led by Phoebe, our Chief Revenue Officer and we’re currently focused on winning new businesses and selecting the right customers to partner with for long term mutual success.

The opportunity

You’ll take Griffin’s licensed bank and banking-as-a-service proposition to mid-market and enterprise companies in payments, lending, proptech, vertical SaaS, insurtech and digital assets. You’ll own each deal from first lead to signed commercial terms. You’ll show their engineering, product, risk and compliance teams how it all works, from API architecture and safeguarding to ledger flows, and talk with confidence to their CFO, COO or CTO. You’ll build your own pipeline, shape pricing for complex accounts with RevOps and Finance, and work with Legal, Compliance and Product on bespoke client needs. Think solutions architect who closes.

What success looks like

Within 12 months, you’ll have built a pipeline you sourced yourself, with deals that are bigger and more structured as you go. Prospects’ CFOs and CTOs will trust you to explain how it all works, and Legal, Compliance and Product will bring you in early on every non-standard deal.

To do this you’ll own

  • Your pipeline, from first lead to signed commercial terms, including sourcing your own leads alongside whatever SDRs and marketing bring in

  • Whiteboard sessions on account structures, and the technical proposal content, which you’ll write yourself

  • Pricing and commercial structures for complex accounts, such as consumption-based or bundled models, tiered volume and transfer pricing, built with RevOps and Finance

  • Regulatory and compliance questions, answered before they turn into objections

  • Commercial and technical arrangements for non-standard client requirements, shaped with Legal, Compliance and Product

Your background

To ensure this, we’re looking for people who have:

  • Built and closed their own pipeline, and get their energy from chasing and winning new business

  • A strong grasp of payments and banking infrastructure (settlement, safeguarding, ledgers, APIs, card and account issuing) and enough regulatory knowledge (EMI versus bank licence, Consumer Duty, safeguarding rules) to hold a credible conversation with a compliance team

  • Sold complex deals with long cycles and several buying committees, and negotiated beyond simple discounting, including pricing models, volume commitments and contractual carve-outs

  • A low ego and high curiosity, with a real appetite for understanding how the plumbing works

  • The resilience for long, technical sales cycles, and the confidence to work without a fixed script while our products and structures evolve

  • A love of writing - we have a major amount of written documentation that you will be contributing to, and we place a high degree of importance on clarity and readability (you can find out more here about how we write)


Nice to haves

Ideally, you would also:

  • Have worked at a BaaS provider, EMI or challenger bank, including in an SMCR-regulated environment

  • Have a structuring background, such as transaction structuring, treasury or Big 4 financial services advisory

What can we offer you?

We are an early stage startup and we're working hard to expand our benefits package. We're planning to add to this list in the future.

  • Salary: Up to £100,000 + commission

  • Remote-first flexibility: Work from anywhere in the UK. However, for this role you will need to be comfortable with regular travel to London, often at short notice.

  • Work from abroad: Up to 20 days a year

  • Time off: 25 days’ holiday, bank holidays and a winter break (we shut down between Christmas and New Year)

  • Share options: Own a part of what we’re building together

  • Pension: Auto-enrolment into our Penfold scheme

  • Insurance: Private medical with Bupa (including family cover) and life insurance with AIG

  • Wellbeing: 1:1 coaching and therapy session available through Oliva

  • Family leave: Enhanced parental leave with up to 6 months on full pay after two years’ service

  • AI tools: Everyone has a Claude subscription on us and access to other premium tools

  • Your setup: We’ll support you in creating a comfortable and effective WFH environment.

How long will the process take?

We move as fast as possible, but it normally takes us about 2-3 weeks to get to know to each other.

  • Step 1: An initial phone call with our Talent Team for us to tell you more about Griffin and learn about your recent experience.

  • Step 2: Meet your manager to talk through your experience and how that relates to the requirements.

  • Step 3: A task based on what you’ll be doing on a day to day at Griffin.

  • Step 4: Meet with peers in your team for a more in-depth technical interview.

  • Step 5: Pitch the Founder and CRevO

  • Step 6: Culture interview: Learn more about this here.

As a bank, we’re committed to maintaining the highest standards of security. This means that the successful candidate will need to complete background screening, and our offer will be conditional upon satisfactory review of these checks. This would include verification of right to work, criminal record, credit history, social media and professional reference checks

How do I apply?

Are we your next move? Apply via the link below, if there's a match our Talent team will reach out to schedule an initial conversation and talk you through what happens next.

Under representation

At Griffin, we’re looking for people who instinctively vibe with our values, behaviours and mission. You’re encouraged to apply, even if your experience doesn’t tick every box. Careers, like life, can take many twists and turns. Your technical expertise and path to where you are today will stand out. We're committed to creating a place where everyone belongs and we welcome diverse perspectives, backgrounds and people who are ready to build a global platform for programmable finance
