title: Financial Administrator
description: Hi, I'm Alex, Finance Manager at FeedbackFruits. 👋 Our Finance team is ramping up over the next couple of years, and we are looking for someone to join the team on a 24-32 hour basis ! Finance here runs across two entities, a Dutch BV and a US Corp, each with its own invoicing, tax and banking rules. Our customers are universities all over the world, so the work ranges from a straightforward Dutch invoice to a US procurement portal with its own supplier onboarding forms and submission rules. The role is broader than most financial administration jobs at this level, and we are searching for someone who's ready to own it. I'm looking for a Financial Administrator to take on our day-to-day operations: billing and collections on the receivables side, supplier invoices and payment runs on the payables side, and the Finance mailbox where everything is coordinated. A lot of our processes are still manual, with limited documented processes. You'd be doing the work and improving it at the same time, formalising operating procedures as you go. The ideal team member is someone who notices when a workflow is clumsy, and is proactive in addressing it. We're a small team of two, and we support the wider organisation with a vast range of topics. You'd work closely with our New Business and Partner Success teams when it comes to billing, and with our Marketing team when it comes to purchasing. When an invoice goes out on time, a university pays on schedule or a purchasing inquiry is resolved ahead of an event, that's visible, and it will be thanks to you. Financial administration can often be limited to a narrow scope of topics within a larger team. If you're eager to get the full picture of operations in a company with an international customer base, this is the right place for it. What you'll do: Send out sales invoices on time. This includes setting up new customers and uploading invoices to procurement portals such as Ariba and PaymentWorks Set up and maintain customer subscriptions in the ERP system based on signed contracts, and create invoices and credit notes for all legal entities Keep track of unpaid invoices, send payment reminders to institutions that haven’t paid, and flag invoices that stay unpaid Partner with Sales and Partner Success to address billing and payment queries Ensure supplier invoices and expenses are processed on time Prepare the weekly payment run for approval Compare bank transactions with our accounting records and resolve any discrepancies Manage the Finance mailbox: customer invoice and payment questions, supplier requests, supplier onboarding forms, and internal requests that come in through the ticketing system Support month-end close and annual accounts Write down how finance processes work in the Finance database in Notion, and update it when you improve them What you bring: You stay accurate and organised during busy periods. At month-end you keep daily work running smoothly while closing the month. You follow things through to the end, in a friendly way. Late payments, missing details or an invoice that needs to match a contract: you stay on it until it’s sorted, and people enjoy working with you. You take ownership of your work from start to finish. You plan your own week, set your own priorities and keep things moving. You speak up when something in the numbers looks off, so we can fix it together. You enjoy working with tools and software, and like finding new ways to get more out of them. You’re comfortable building things as you go. You ask good questions, fill in the gaps and make sure you know the next steps before you start. You have at least one year of experience in a finance or similar administrative role (two or more is a plus), including hands-on work with billing or subscriptions. We care more about your experience than your degree. You’ve worked with an accounting system or ERP, such as Exact Online, NetSuite, Dynamics or SAP. Experience with Exact Online, Moss or procurement portals is a bonus You write and speak English fluently, as we use it for all internal and external work. You’re available 24 to 32 hours per week and can work from our Amsterdam office 2-3 days a week. What you get: 25 paid holidays per year, based on a 40-hour work week Hybrid work schedule (2-3 days onsite) A day off for your birthday Advantageous pension scheme 3 days of volunteering leave per year €550 Learning & Development budget per year + 3 days paid leave for learning Travel allowance and Swapfiets subscription Free access to our office gym Unlimited access to mental health support via OpenUp (EU, US, and AUS) Compensation: €33,600 – €36,480 • Estimated base salary for this role, based on a 32-hour work week is between: €33,600 – €36,480 Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Propulsion Engineer - Electric Engine (all genders)
description: Your Mission: As a Senior Propulsion Engineer – Electric Engine, you will drive the development of the electric engine for the VÆRIDION Microliner. You will act as VÆRIDION’s internal technical expert for the complete electric engine, including the motor and controller. You will be responsible for decomposing aircraft-level requirements into engine requirements, guiding technical decisions, and ensuring compliance with applicable certification requirements. Working closely with the engine supplier, you will critically review and challenge the engine architecture, detailed design, technical analyses, test results and certification evidence. You will maintain a holistic technical overview of the complete electric engine, including the electric machine, engine controllers, power electronics, thermal management, mechanical interfaces, control functions and supporting hardware and software. As a senior member of the Propulsion team, you will play a key role in technical decision-making, supplier management, testing and certification activities, helping to bring one of the world's most advanced electric aircraft propulsion systems into service. Your Day-to-Day: Lead the development and certification of the electric engine throughout its complete lifecycle, from requirements definition through testing and certification Act as VÆRIDION’s electric engine subject-matter expert and primary technical counterpart to the external engine supplier. Define, maintain and manage electric engine requirements, interfaces, operating limitations and verification strategies. Review and challenge supplier architectures, designs, calculations, simulation models, and substantiation reports, identifying technical gaps and proposing solutions. Evaluate the electric engine performance across its operating envelope, including efficiency, dynamic response, control stability, thermal limits and performance margins. Contribute to system safety activities, including Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA), Failure Mode Effect Analyses (FMEA) and System Safety Assessments (SSA), in accordance with applicable airworthiness and safety standards. Identify and assess applicable certification requirements, means of compliance and industry standards, including relevant aspects of EASA SC E-19, and ensure that certification considerations are addressed throughout the development cycle. Coordinate the electric engine development and qualification test campaigns, in collaboration with the testing team, including the definition of test plans, objectives, and success criteria. Review and assess test results, identify technical risks and deviations, and coordinate the resolution of issues encountered during testing. Prepare and review technical documentation, including specifications, interface documents, design reviews, qualification reports, and compliance statements. Support prototype build, aircraft integration and ground/flight testing activities throughout the maturation of the propulsion system Your Profile: Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related technical field. At least 8 years of relevant professional experience in the development, integration or testing of electric motors, engine controllers/inverters or integrated electric-drive systems. Strong knowledge of electric machines and power electronics, including motor topologies, inverter architectures, operating characteristics & limits, losses & thermal behaviour, motor control strategies & protection functions, and manufacturing processes. Broad understanding of electric engine development, including thermal management, insulation systems, high-voltage systems, EMC, mechanical integrity, reliability & durability, and system integration. Experience defining and managing technical requirements, specifications, interfaces and verification strategies for electric engines or electric-drive systems. Experience collaborating with external development partners, engineering service providers or aerospace suppliers. A high degree of self-motivation, resilience, reliability and precision, combined with a strong sense of ownership. Strong analytical, technical-writing and written communication skills. Excellent verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in another European language is an asset. Passionate about aviation and the electrification of the aviation industry. Previous experience as a Certification Verification Engineer or in a comparable compliance-related role is a plus. Familiarity with EASA SC E-19 and its application to electric or hybrid propulsion systems would be an advantage. Experience in verification, validation and qualification of electric engines, including performance, thermal, endurance and environmental testing, would be a plus. Previous experience working within an EASA Part 21J Design Organisation or an international equivalent is a plus. Knowledge of systems engineering and safety assessment methodologies, such as SAE ARP4754A and ARP4761, would be beneficial. Specialized expertise in thermal management, high-voltage insulation systems, EMC, electric machine mechanics and vibration, or propulsion-system integration is an advantage. We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist. Why us? raw.title: Senior Propulsion Engineer - Electric Engine (all genders)
raw.description:
Your Mission:

As a Senior Propulsion Engineer – Electric Engine, you will drive the development of the electric engine for the VÆRIDION Microliner. You will act as VÆRIDION’s internal technical expert for the complete electric engine, including the motor and controller. You will be responsible for decomposing aircraft-level requirements into engine requirements, guiding technical decisions, and ensuring compliance with applicable certification requirements.

Working closely with the engine supplier, you will critically review and challenge the engine architecture, detailed design, technical analyses, test results and certification evidence. You will maintain a holistic technical overview of the complete electric engine, including the electric machine, engine controllers, power electronics, thermal management, mechanical interfaces, control functions and supporting hardware and software.

As a senior member of the Propulsion team, you will play a key role in technical decision-making, supplier management, testing and certification activities, helping to bring one of the world's most advanced electric aircraft propulsion systems into service.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead the development and certification of the electric engine throughout its complete lifecycle, from requirements definition through testing and certification

  • Act as VÆRIDION’s electric engine subject-matter expert and primary technical counterpart to the external engine supplier.

  • Define, maintain and manage electric engine requirements, interfaces, operating limitations and verification strategies.

  • Review and challenge supplier architectures, designs, calculations, simulation models, and substantiation reports, identifying technical gaps and proposing solutions.

  • Evaluate the electric engine performance across its operating envelope, including efficiency, dynamic response, control stability, thermal limits and performance margins.

  • Contribute to system safety activities, including Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA), Failure Mode Effect Analyses (FMEA) and System Safety Assessments (SSA), in accordance with applicable airworthiness and safety standards.

  • Identify and assess applicable certification requirements, means of compliance and industry standards, including relevant aspects of EASA SC E-19, and ensure that certification considerations are addressed throughout the development cycle.

  • Coordinate the electric engine development and qualification test campaigns, in collaboration with the testing team, including the definition of test plans, objectives, and success criteria.

  • Review and assess test results, identify technical risks and deviations, and coordinate the resolution of issues encountered during testing.

  • Prepare and review technical documentation, including specifications, interface documents, design reviews, qualification reports, and compliance statements.

  • Support prototype build, aircraft integration and ground/flight testing activities throughout the maturation of the propulsion system

 

Your Profile:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related technical field.

  • At least 8 years of relevant professional experience in the development, integration or testing of electric motors, engine controllers/inverters or integrated electric-drive systems.

  • Strong knowledge of electric machines and power electronics, including motor topologies, inverter architectures, operating characteristics & limits, losses & thermal behaviour, motor control strategies & protection functions, and manufacturing processes.

  • Broad understanding of electric engine development, including thermal management, insulation systems, high-voltage systems, EMC, mechanical integrity, reliability & durability, and system integration.

  • Experience defining and managing technical requirements, specifications, interfaces and verification strategies for electric engines or electric-drive systems.

  • Experience collaborating with external development partners, engineering service providers or aerospace suppliers.

  • A high degree of self-motivation, resilience, reliability and precision, combined with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Strong analytical, technical-writing and written communication skills.

  • Excellent verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in another European language is an asset.

  • Passionate about aviation and the electrification of the aviation industry.

  • Previous experience as a Certification Verification Engineer or in a comparable compliance-related role is a plus.

  • Familiarity with EASA SC E-19 and its application to electric or hybrid propulsion systems would be an advantage.

  • Experience in verification, validation and qualification of electric engines, including performance, thermal, endurance and environmental testing, would be a plus.

  • Previous experience working within an EASA Part 21J Design Organisation or an international equivalent is a plus.

  • Knowledge of systems engineering and safety assessment methodologies, such as SAE ARP4754A and ARP4761, would be beneficial.

  • Specialized expertise in thermal management, high-voltage insulation systems, EMC, electric machine mechanics and vibration, or propulsion-system integration is an advantage.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Climate
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Flexport:&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p>At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.&nbsp;</p> <p>The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.</p></div><h3><strong>Why Climate Matters More Than Ever</strong></h3> <p>Supply chain leaders are being asked to cut costs and carbon at the same time. Yet logistics and sustainability teams often work with different data, tools, and priorities. Meanwhile, regulations and industry standards are raising expectations for how companies measure and manage their emissions.</p> <p>Most climate tools stop at reporting: a dashboard or a year-end PDF, produced long after a shipment has moved. They rarely reach the people deciding how to route goods, when to ship, or how much inventory to hold.</p> <p>The Climate team at Flexport is building emissions intelligence directly into the platform where supply chain decisions are made. We help customers weigh cost, speed, and emissions together—and turn that understanding into action.</p> <h2><strong>The Opportunity</strong></h2> <p>Flexport already runs the shipments, holds the data, and provides the platform where customers manage their supply chains. That puts us in a strong position to connect climate insights with the operational decisions that drive emissions.</p> <p>You will be the primary engineer for Climate, working independently of our existing engineering teams and partnering closely with the Climate Manager, your main day-to-day business stakeholder.</p> <p>Think of it as a small startup within Flexport: direct access to the business, a broad scope, and substantial ownership. Together with the Climate Manager, you will identify the most valuable problems to solve, shape the product direction, and turn ideas into reliable software. This role calls for someone who enjoys both deciding what to build and building it.</p> <p><strong>Things We ❤️</strong></p> <ul> <li>Turning complex shipment and emissions data into clear, actionable choices.</li> <li>Working directly with stakeholders and users to understand what would make their lives better.</li> <li>Building simple, reliable products and learning from how people use them.</li> <li>Finding opportunities where lower costs and lower emissions go together.</li> <li>Taking an idea from an ambiguous problem to a useful product in production.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You Will</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Work closely with Climate Programs Manager to understand customer needs, challenge assumptions, and translate business goals into a practical product roadmap.</li> <li>Own delivery from problem discovery and technical design through implementation, launch, operation, and iteration.</li> <li>Build emissions intelligence into everyday supply chain decisions, including routing, transport mode, shipment timing, and inventory planning.</li> <li>Help customers identify opportunities to reduce emissions using Flexport’s shipment data.</li> <li>Make lower-emission choices easier to understand and act on within existing workflows.</li> <li>Develop products that help customers understand the wider environmental footprint of their supply chains, beyond freight.</li> <li>Deliver useful improvements incrementally, balancing speed, scope, maintainability, and data accuracy.</li> <li>Coordinate with other engineering teams when your work depends on shared systems, integrations, or expertise.</li> <li>Measure whether what you ship solves the underlying problem, and use that evidence to decide what comes next.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You Should Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>5+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong engineering foundation and experience delivering production software.</li> <li>A track record of working independently: you can bring structure to an unclear problem, set priorities, unblock yourself, and follow through without a detailed specification or constant direction.</li> <li>Strong product judgment: you understand user needs, identify what is worth building, and make thoughtful tradeoffs between impact and effort.</li> <li>Experience working closely with business stakeholders: you ask good questions, explain technical choices in plain language, and constructively challenge ideas when needed.</li> <li>The ability to own features across the stack, including user interfaces, backend services, and data integrations.</li> <li>A love of simple, well-tested code that is easy to extend and hard to break.</li> <li>Comfort taking responsibility for the reliability and maintenance of what you build.</li> <li>A bias for action, combined with the judgment to recognize when you need input or help.</li> <li>An aptitude for learning quickly, including unfamiliar business domains and technologies.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A personal motivation to work on climate and environmental challenges.</li> <li>Experience in climate technology, emissions accounting, logistics, or supply chain software.</li> <li>Experience building products in a startup or another small team with broad ownership.</li> <li>Experience turning complex data into customer-facing insights and decision tools.</li> </ul> <p>Prior climate experience is a plus; curiosity and the ability to learn the domain matter more.</p> <h2><strong>How We Work</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Your day-to-day work will center on a close partnership with the Climate Manager, with collaboration across engineering as needed.</li> <li>You will have substantial autonomy and will be expected to keep stakeholders aligned on priorities, progress, and tradeoffs.</li> <li>We build and launch incrementally, using feedback to guide the next step.</li> <li>In Amsterdam, we come to the office two description: About MotherDuck Don’t let the quirky name fool you: At MotherDuck , we’re on a mission to make data warehousing fun, frictionless, and ducking awesome for developers and data practitioners building blazing fast internal and customer-facing analytics experiences. We're building a cloud-hosted version of DuckDB, working hand-in-hand with the creators of the fastest-growing and fastest-improving query engine on the planet. Unlike other databases, MotherDuck was architected to unify local development with cloud operations to bridge the gap between software and data engineering workflows. Our team is a mix of thoughtful, passionate, and empathetic data industry veterans. What you will do The Database team is the bridge between DuckDB and the cloud. We own the core server and client extension logic that lets DuckDB run seamlessly, whether it's local or in the cloud, and we work in C++ right alongside the DuckDB codebase itself. Our mission is to push the boundaries of embedded database performance, distributed execution, and user experience, all while staying closely connected to DuckDB Labs (the team behind DuckDB) to align on APIs and shape what's next. Day to day, we drive major projects in dual execution, resource assignment, and system reliability, while also handling incoming issues and lending our DuckDB expertise to other teams. We collaborate closely across MotherDuck and with the wider DuckDB community, making sure people get the best of both local and cloud worlds. It's a small, high-agency team with big ambitions... the kind of place where engineers own impactful projects, share what they learn, and help shape how modern analytics gets built. This role is ideally based in Amsterdam or Berlin, but we are also open to great candidates remotely in Europe. Key Responsibilities: Own major projects in our dual execution stack, so DuckDB can process queries seamlessly whether they're running locally or in the cloud. Help build a cloud platform that dynamically assigns resources, so DuckDB stays efficient whether someone's running a tiny workload or pushing our biggest, highest-memory instances. Lead cross-functional work with our frontend, platform, and infrastructure teams to keep the user experience coherent end to end. Push the state of the art in embedded database performance, distributed execution, and DuckDB internals. Deepen your DuckDB expertise and share it with the rest of the company through mentorship and documentation. Work directly with our support team to debug issues, learn from real usage patterns, and prioritize the improvements that matter most. Improve systems holistically... spotting architectural challenges early and clearing bottlenecks before they become problems. Mentor teammates and help raise the bar for engineering practices across the team. Work closely with DuckDB Labs (which grew out of the Database Architectures group at CWI, where vectorized execution and DuckDB were born) to help align on APIs and shape where DuckDB goes next. What you bring You've built and shipped complex backend systems, and you know what great looks like. You're fluent in a backend language like C++, Rust, Java, or similar systems languages, and you're comfortable working close to the metal. (C++ and Rust are the biggest plus here, and we love a great Java engineer too.) A good foundation in query engines, execution plans, indexing, and performance optimization techniques. Hands-on experience with DuckDB is a huge plus, no matter what level you're coming in at. You've worked with cloud infrastructure, networking, and building low-latency distributed systems. You can scope and lead projects that span multiple collaborators and cross-functional dependencies. You take pride in clear thinking, careful design, and thoughtful tradeoffs. You're comfortable mentoring peers and helping build a collaborative, high-agency environment. You enjoy engaging with the wider community, whether that's open-source conversations or working directly with DuckDB Labs. What we provide The opportunity to participate and contribute to DuckDB, one of most popular modern open source analytical databases. Competitive salary and stock options so you have a stake in our flock’s success. Flexible time off – take the time you need to recharge, explore, or just have a lazy day by the pond. A good pension plan Legendary company events – we bring the whole flock together once a year for unforgettable team gatherings a year to keep our bonds strong. Hybrid work environment – Spend three days a week in the office collaborating with the flock, and work from wherever you’re most productive the rest of the time—whether that’s your home office, a coffee shop, or a peaceful lakeside retreat. We have to warn you though, most of us like the office so much we come anyway. It’s on the river Ij, with a great lunch every day. title: Senior Projectmanager
description: Jouw Missie bij CCS Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam. Voordelen voor de sollicitant Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar). Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks. En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch? Een voorbeeld van je werkdag Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen. Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan. Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant. Wie jij bent De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten: · Je wordt blij van projectmanagement en blijft kalm bij verschuivende prioriteiten; · Je hebt bewezen ervaring met het succesvol uitvoeren van productsoftware-implementaties in een complexe, maar klantgerichte omgeving, binnen budget, planning en scope; · Je hebt ruime ervaring met diverse projectmanagement en delivery methodieken, bij voorkeur een Prince2-, Ipma of PMI of Agile / scrum certificaat; · Je vindt, net als wij, klanttevredenheid het uitgangspunt. Daarbij ben je in staat om de klantverwachtingen helder te analyseren, te managen en actief bij te sturen waar nodig; · Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift; · Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch; · Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties; · Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica. Wat bieden wij jou? Naast de genoemde leuke functie binnen een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf bieden wij: · Salaris : We bieden je een salaris tussen € 5.590 en € 7.958 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van je ervaring en kennis; · Middelen : Leaseauto, laptop, telefoon; · Werkdagen : Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar, al heeft 5 dagen onze voorkeur; · Vergoeding voor thuiswerken : Je kunt gedeeltelijk thuiswerken en krijgt een onkostenvergoeding van € 2,40 per thuiswerkdag. Ook krijg je een budget van € 750,- om thuis een ergonomische werkplek in te richten; · Workation : Je kunt tot 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar vanuit het buitenland werken; · Leuke teamactiviteiten : Leer je collega’s beter kennen door deel te nemen aan maandelijkse evenementen georganiseerd door ons energieke Fun-team, zoals een pubquiz, Zomer BBQ, wine & beer tastings en movie night; · Vakantiedagen : Je krijgt 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om maximaal 20 extra dagen bij te kopen; · Groei en ontwikkelin g: De mogelijkheid om je vaardigheden en verantwoordelijkheden te ontwikkelen binnen de functie, middels opleidingen en Linkedin learning, of door te stromen naar een van de andere functies binnen CCS; · Vakantiegeld : Jaarlijks 8,33%; · Voordelen : Je krijgt een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling met een lage eigen bijdrage en kunt gebruikmaken van collectieve verzekeringen met korting. Ook is er een bedrijfsfitnessregeling voor een gezonde levensstijl en een fietsregeling voor duurzaam vervoer. Waarom CCS? Omdat wij geloven dat werk meer is dan een baan. Het is een plek waar je jezelf kunt zijn, impact kunt maken en kunt groeien. Het is een omgeving waar je wordt geïnspireerd om het beste uit jezelf te halen en samen te werken aan een duurzame toekomst. Kom bij ons en ontdek wat er mogelijk is als je een carrière bouwt vol passie, plezier en betekenis. Jij bent de ontbrekende schakel in ons team. Word onderdeel van ons verhaal. 🚀 Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Netwerk Consultant
description: Bouw mee aan de netwerken die Nederland draaiende houden Ben jij een ervaren Network Consultant die complexe netwerkomgevingen weet om te zetten in veilige, stabiele en toekomstbestendige oplossingen? Wil je werken aan uitdagende infrastructuren voor klanten in zowel de publieke als private sector? Dan is dit jouw kans om impact te maken bij Centric. Wat jij doet Als Network Consultant binnen Cloud & Dataservices (DC & Network Services) ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, implementeren en beheren van complexe netwerkinfrastructuren. Je werkt met moderne technologieën zoals routers, switches, firewalls, WAF's en load balancers binnen zowel private als public cloudomgevingen. Samen met een team van gespecialiseerde netwerk consultant zorg je ervoor dat onze diensten veilig, beschikbaar, geautomatiseerd en efficiënt worden geleverd aan onze klanten. Wat ga je doen? Implementeren en beheren van geavanceerde netwerkomgevingen Configureren en beheren van routers, switches, wireless, firewalls, WAF's en load balancers Vertalen van architectuurontwerpen naar concrete technische implementaties Uitvoeren van patch-, lifecycle- en securitymanagement Monitoren, analyseren en optimaliseren van netwerkprestaties Werken volgens ITIL-processen en bijdragen aan continue verbetering Ontwikkelen van innovatieve netwerkoplossingen voor onze klanten Dit breng jij mee Wij zorgen voor een werkomgeving waar jij blij kunt zijn en gewaardeerd wordt. Andersom voeg jij als Netwerk Consultant waarde toe met jouw: HBO werk- en denkniveau; Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal; Je beschikt over relevante certificeringen, zoals Cisco CCNP, Aruba, Fortinet NSE4/NSE5, Microsoft AZ-700/AZ-900, Citrix Netscaler, F5 en ITIL Foundation, of bent bereid deze te behalen; Kennis van routing- en switching concepten; Kennis van VPN-technologieën, Zero Trust, NAC en MFA-integraties; Ervaring met firewalls, WAF's en load balancers; Ervaring met wireless oplossingen van Fortinet, Aruba en Ubiquiti Ervaring met scripting- en netwerk automation; Je bent in staat om een basis netwerk design (HLD) te vertalen naar een concrete configuratie en Visio tekeningen (LLD); Kennis van VLAN, BGP, OSPF, MPLS/VPLS, GSLB en policy-based routing; Je bent communicatief sterk, oplossingsgericht, zelfstandig en klantgericht; Je bent bereid om deel te nemen aan stand-by diensten en incidenteel buiten kantooruren werkzaamheden uit te voeren. Dit krijg je Bij Centric vind je veel flexibiliteit en vrijheid om jouw vak als Netwerk Consultant succesvol uit te oefenen. Zo heb je veel ruimte om te bepalen hoe jij jouw werkweek indeelt. Ook kies je (deels) zelf waarvandaan jij werkt: vanaf kantoor, thuis of andere locaties. Verder kun je voor deze functie rekenen op: Een marktconforme salaris; Tot 26 vakantiedagen en 8% vakantietoeslag die we in mei uitbetalen; Een bijdrage aan je pensioen van 7,5% van je pensioengrondslag; Loyaliteitsdagen: des te langer je bij ons werkt des te meer vrije tijd; Een thuiswerkvergoeding tot € 15,00 per maan; Onbeperkte mogelijkheden voor het volgen van opleidingen. Centric helpt jou graag slagen; Een bonus tot € 1.500,00 als jij een nieuwe collega aan ons voorstelt. Dit zijn de arbeidsvoorwaarden op basis van een 40-urige werkweek. Voor een overzicht van alle arbeidsvoorwaarden ga je naar careers.centric.eu/nl/jij-en-centric/arbeidsvoorwaarden Omring jezelf met mogelijkheden bij Centric Wil jij met jouw kennis en ervaring Centric naar een nóg hoger niveau brengen? Solliciteer dan nu via onze website op de vacature van Netwerk Consultant bij Centric. Voor meer informatie over de functie kun je contact opnemen met onze Recruiter, Marlou de Bruijn via +31 6 29554532, of  Hier starten jouw kansen Zonder dat je het misschien weet, ben je al eens met Centric in aanraking geweest. Als je betaalt in de winkel. Als je een glas kraanwater drinkt. Als je een paspoort aanvraagt. Duizenden organisaties en hun miljoenen klanten rekenen elke dag weer op onze 200+ technologische oplossingen, hoogwaardige IT-diensten en 3.000 gekwalificeerde professionals. Samen zorgen we dat belangrijke processen in onze samenleving altijd doordraaien.  Bij Centric Services werk je aan innovatieve oplossingen voor gemeenten, overheden, retailers, banken en vele andere sectoren. Je draagt dagelijks bij aan het leveren van een sterk full scope IT-services concept met een Nederlands karakter. Ons concept omvat alles van cloud- en applicatiebeheer tot het creëren van veilige en toekomstbestendige werkomgevingen, maatwerkapplicaties en detachering.
